combineLevel.description:
Number of levels of grouping.  For example, if facilities contain systems, and systems contain subsystems, you
have three possible levels of grouping: facilities, systems, and subsystems.  With `combineLevel` set to 1,
only the facilities would be grouped; the systems and subsystems under the facilities would remain as individual
nodes.

collapseCombinedNodesOnLoad.description:
Whether or not to initial render the graph in a combined / grouped state.  When true the nodes will be rendered in
their groups in a closed state.

combineOutlineColor.description: The hex or rgb outline color for the combine group.

combineProperties.description: Fields to group nodes by, ordered from lowest-level grouping to highest.

combineShape.description: The shape the combined node will be.

summaryLinkColor.description: The hex or rgb color for the summary links.

summaryLinkLineStyle.description: The line style of the summary links.

summaryLinkWidth.description: The width of the summary link.

useSummaryLinks.description: Configuration to control if multiple links between 2 groups should be displayed as a single link.

enableDragNodesIntoOrOutOfCombo.description: When true, users may drag nodes into or out of a combined group.

enableSelectMultipleNodesForNewCombo.description: When true, users may select multiple nodes, and click a button to combine them into a new combo group.

title: The config for controlling when the nodes should combine into groups.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationCombineConfig
